description: Exact rating distribution for one app over a window: total reviews, average rating, reviews per star and developer replies, also by app version (newest first, then other and unknown) and by week (weeks start Monday, UTC). Counts are the reviews Rivioo holds in the window, not users or every review ever written. App Store results are per country. Google Play results are per language, from all countries: the country picks the languages (English plus its main language). Use it for ratings, versions and weekly trends, and before reading reviews to see when ratings changed. Free; returns no review text. Collects newer reviews automatically when held reviews are older than max_age_hours.

app_id.description: Numeric App Store id (such as 324684580) or Google Play package name (such as com.spotify.music), from rivioo_my_apps or rivioo_find_app.

app_version.description: Only reviews of this exact app version.

country.description: Two-letter storefront country such as us or gb. For the App Store it picks the country's reviews; for Google Play it picks the review languages (English plus the country's main language), read from all countries. Optional for saved apps, which use the user's default country.

days.description: Window of this many days ending now. Defaults to 30. Use posted_from instead for exact dates.

max_age_hours.description: Reuse reviews collected within this many hours; older data is collected again automatically (newest reviews only). Default 24.

posted_before.description: Window end, exclusive. Defaults to now.

posted_from.description: Window start, inclusive, in UTC unless an offset is given. Use instead of days.

store.description: 'ios' for the App Store or 'android' for Google Play.

name: rivioo_review_stats

app_reviews_url.description: The app's reviews page in the store. Not a link to any single review.

country.description: The App Store country read, or for Google Play the country that picked the languages.

label.description: What these reviews cover, to name in answers: an App Store country, or Google Play languages from all countries.

languages.description: Google Play review languages read. Null for the App Store, which is read by country.

app_version.description: Version string, 'other' for versions beyond the newest 15, or 'unknown' when the store gave none.

partial.description: The window covers only part of this week.

cached.description: true when the results come from reviews collected before this call.

collected_at.description: When the held reviews were last collected, UTC.

contiguous_from.description: Rivioo holds every review posted after this time, up to collected_at.

languages.description: Google Play review languages covered. Null for the App Store.

reviews_held.description: Reviews Rivioo holds for this App Store country or these Google Play languages, all dates.

window_covered.description: true when the held reviews cover the whole window without gaps.

notes.description: Short facts about this result: what the reviews cover, whether the sample is small, what the counts mean and how reviews are identified.

charged_this_call.description: Reviews this call read for the first time in 30 days.

free_rereads_this_call.description: Reviews this call returned free because they were first read in the last 30 days.

remaining.description: Reviews this account can still read for the first time this month.

status.description: fresh: collected during this call. cached: held reviews within max_age_hours. collecting: a collection is still running and results are partial. stale: older than max_age_hours. collection_failed: the latest collection failed.

title: Review stats
